title: Your AI nutrition coach. Tell it what you ate, ask it anything · Fabee
excerpt: Fabee is an AI nutrition coach for iPhone. Text what you ate or snap your plate: it logs the calories and macros and gives you advice that fits your day.

Hi, I'm Fabee, your AI nutrition coach.

Fabee coaches. Calorie apps count.

Get advice that fits you. Text what you ate or snap your plate. Fabee counts the calories and macros and helps you hit your goal, whether you’re losing, gaining or hitting your own macros.

Frequently asked questions

What is Fabee?

Fabee is an AI nutrition coach for iPhone that you use by chatting. You type or dictate what you ate, and it logs the calories, protein, carbs and fat of each food on a card. Then ask it anything about your day, your week or what to eat next.

Do I need to weigh my food?

No. Say it the way you’d tell a friend: a bowl of pasta, two slices of toast, a big coffee. Fabee uses a normal portion when you don’t give one, and you can change any amount.

What about homemade meals and restaurants?

Describe what was on the plate. Fabee splits a dish into its parts and counts each one, so your own recipes and restaurant meals work too.

What if it gets something wrong?

Say so. “It was two eggs, not three” and the card updates. You can also tap any amount and change it.

Where does my data go?

Your food log and photos stay on your iPhone. If you turn on sync, a copy is saved to your Fabee account on our servers in the EU, so a new iPhone gets it back. To write a reply, your message goes through our server to an AI model that keeps nothing. The privacy policy has the details.

Are there ads?

No. Fabee is paid for by its subscription, not by ads.

How much does it cost?

Fabee is a subscription, and the first 3 days are free. You’ll see the price in the App Store before you start.

When can I use it?

Now. Fabee is on the App Store for iPhone.
